title: Donation and Charity
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 9 (Parts 1 and 2) by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Giving by the sign in the 9th, 5th and 2nd houses, secret giving, exam-day remedies and the question and answer rounds.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 9, Donation and Charity (Parts 1 and 2) by Brajesh Gautam: what to give by sign, where to give, the 5th house and schools, exam remedies and Q&A, with video timestamps.
points: Fate is fixed, grace is not.
The speaker says the chart does not change, but grace changes how it plays out, and giving is one way to take grace.
What to give at a temple, school or cash box depends on the sign in the matching house. A friend planet's item helps, an enemy's can hurt.
A gift that belongs to a planet unfriendly to your sign can make matters worse, so do not give blindly.
Giving quietly and without regret is said to lift the 8th house.
If temple prayer fails, he says take the ancestors' grace first, and give at schools and to children.
Colours, pocket items, threads and food are matched to the signs on the study houses. These are his beliefs.
The wish to receive is what makes one fit to be given to, he says.
